input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 (branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly three tasks and exactly two cohorts, named alpha and beta, neither depending on the other. T1: a composite counts each finding once per task and keeps stages apart (observation/src/grading/composite.ts). T2: a declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts). T3: a drilldown's nested lists page separately (observation/src/grading/composite.ts). Cohort alpha carries T1 and T2. Cohort beta carries T1 and T3. T1 is the same task in both cohorts, under the same id.
The operator authorizes this audit path: each builder publishes the existing PR #793 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. Each builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #793, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e.
Each assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task of its cohort, naming that task id. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/composite.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and briefs short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

risks.mitigation: Run bun install only if needed, run bun run --filter observation test exactly once per builder, and publish the real counts and output; record an inability to run as a known issue rather than inventing results.
risks.description: The observation package test command includes integration tests and can fail because dependencies or test services are unavailable even when the audited code is unchanged.

risks.mitigation: Adopt the proposed assessor-protocol clarification so the assessment artifact is the assessor's only write and no pull-request mutation is attempted.
risks.description: The generic assessor workflow attempts a pull-request draft-state mutation after assessment, which is incompatible with a strictly read-only audit of the existing PR and may also be inapplicable to an already merged PR.

body.summary: The audit is implementable and the named PR head is available locally at c03533340ab94eb521315a29d0e76a9219c9b906. Repository evidence directly supports T1's per-task, stage-separated composite counting, T2's exact-approved-revision journal gate, and T3's independently paged nested drilldown lists. No operator decision or behavior conflict blocks the audit, but the specification should explicitly override two generic workflow instructions: publish the existing PR artifact before build_result, and suppress the assessor's PR draft-state mutation.

findings.description: T1 is directly auditable at the target tree: selectLinkedContributions admits an occurrence once when any link targets the logical task, and stageComposite filters contributions by stage before counting distinct occurrence/question/grader answer keys (observation/src/grading/composite.ts:157-158 and observation/src/grading/composite.ts:314-360). The shared-task integration case verifies one logical task across alpha and beta, four current implementation findings for T7, and one contribution for a finding also linked to T8 (observation/tests/composite.test.ts:198-216).

T2 is directly auditable at the target tree: journaling looks up an approve decision whose target_revision_id exactly equals declaration.tasks_revision_id before inserting the declaration event (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:758-785), and the approval caller journals links inside the decision transaction only after the decision stands (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:792-807). Tests cover exact-revision approval, non-approval refusal, atomic rollback, and retry (oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:222-284).

T3 is directly auditable at the target tree: DrilldownPages gives rows, questions, links, statuses, current answers, and superseded answers independent windows, and selectDrilldown applies each window separately while preserving whole-list totals (observation/src/grading/composite.ts:425-461). The integration case independently advances question, answer, superseded-answer, link, and status windows (observation/tests/composite.test.ts:406-455).

The specification narrates build_result publication before the existing PR artifact, but the pinned builder contract requires pr first and build_result second and explicitly forbids publishing build_result before pr (workflow-config/prompts/development/build.md:37-44). This does not require an operator choice; the audit exception should retain the generic publication order while replacing only the push/open behavior.

The specification says each assessor assesses without changing anything, but the pinned assessor contract requires a post-publication set_pr_draft call for every verdict (workflow-config/prompts/development/assess.md:43-48). For a genuinely immutable audit of the existing PR, the specification must explicitly say that this audit overrides that draft-state step.

requirements.description: Audit that a composite counts each finding once per task and keeps stages separate in observation/src/grading/composite.ts, with alpha and beta both assessing the same T1 id.
Audit that oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts journals a declaration only after approval of the exact tasks revision, in cohort alpha.
Audit that nested drilldown lists page independently in observation/src/grading/composite.ts, in cohort beta.
Produce exactly tasks T1, T2, and T3 and exactly independent cohorts alpha and beta, assigning alpha T1/T2 and beta T1/T3 with the same T1 id.

Keep builders and assessors read-only over repository and PR state, inspect the named branch head, run and report the specified test honestly, publish the existing PR artifact and build evidence, and provide per-task file plus test/output assessment evidence.
